name: Circular Areal Novel View PVHV
definition: For circular areal views (e.g., DOF rendering), the PVHV is modeled as a revolution of the 2D linear PVHV triangle, forming a cone. The implementation uses the same 2D equation (Eq. 2) but defines $n$ as the farthest view along the projection of $f-s$ onto the novel view plane.
